Summary.en: Turns the tagged container into a collapsible, optionally auto-titled panel.
Summary.de: Verwandelt den markierten Container in ein einklappbares Panel mit optional automatischem Titel.
Summary.it: Trasforma il contenitore contrassegnato in un pannello comprimibile con titolo automatico opzionale.

Parameter.Folded: States whether this panel is folded (TRUE) or unfolded (everything else) when it is loaded (defaults to TRUE).
Parameter.CSSHeaderHover: The optional header's CSS:hover (defaults to { scale : 1.1 ;}).
Parameter.CSSHeaderActive: The optional header's CSS:active (defaults to { scale : .9 ;}).
Parameter.CSSHeaderFolded: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is FOLDED. Without it a panel that is (or starts) folded would lose the header look set via CSSHeaderUnfolded.
Parameter.CSSHeaderUnfolded: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.DCSSHeaderUnfolded: The optional Darkmode CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.CSSAnimFadeINPanel: The optional animation to be applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.CSSAnimFadeINPanelDuration: The optional animation's duration that is applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded (defaults to 0s).
Parameter.CSSAnimFadeINPanelEasing: The optional animation's easing function that is applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded (defaults to "ease-in-out").
Parameter.CSSAfterHeader: The CSS:after to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.
Parameter.CSSBeforeHeader: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
Parameter.CSSAfterHeaderContent: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.
Parameter.CSSBeforeHeaderContent: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
Parameter.CSSAfterHeaderContentUnfolded: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.
Parameter.CSSBeforeHeaderContentUnfolded: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).
Parameter.CSSRequiredFieldsContent: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.
Parameter.CSSRequiredFields: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.
Parameter.AutoHeaderTitle: The string the automatically generated header shall display.
Parameter.AutoHeaderTitleSupplementsSpacer: The string separating the actual title from the strings that're supplemented (values of inputs tagged with the CSS-Class CodBi_HTML_Panel_AutoHeaderTitle_Supplement). Encode surrounding spaces as %20 or \s.
Parameter.AutoHeaderLevel: Which level of enclosing heading the AutoHeaderTitle shall have, e.g. to get a h1 enclosure the value has to be 1.
Parameter.ScrollBlock: Defines the logical position to scroll to when the panel is unfolded (start, center, end, nearest). Defaults to "nearest".
Parameter.GenerateHeader: States whether a header shall be automatically generated. Defaults to FALSE.
Parameter.Scroll: States whether the view shall be scrolled when the panel unfolds. Default is FALSE.
Parameter.ScrollToTop: States whether a round scroll-to-top button shall be displayed at the bottom-right of the unfolded panel. Possible values: "true" (always visible), "auto" (visible only when the panel's content is taller than 1.5x the viewport height), or "false" (hidden). Defaults to AUTO.
Parameter.Accordion: If set, this panel becomes part of an accordion. All panels sharing the same accordion name will be folded when one of them is unfolded.

CSSHeaderHover.default: The optional header's CSS:hover (defaults to { scale : 1.1 ;}).

CSSHeaderActive.default: The optional header's CSS:active (defaults to { scale : .9 ;}).

CSSHeaderUnfolded.default: The optional CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.

DCSSHeaderUnfolded.default: The optional Darkmode CSS to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.

CSSAnimFadeINPanel.default: The optional animation to be applied onto the panel whenever the panel is unfolded.

CSSAfterHeader.default: The CSS:after to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.

CSSBeforeHeader.default: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).

CSSAfterHeaderContent.default: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded.

CSSBeforeHeaderContent.default: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header when the panel is folded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).

CSSAfterHeaderContentUnfolded.default: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded.

CSSBeforeHeaderContentUnfolded.default: The CSS:after content to be applied onto the header when the panel is unfolded (will be overwritten when required fields are contained by the panel).

CSSRequiredFieldsContent.default: The CSS:before content to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.

CSSRequiredFields.default: The CSS:before to be applied onto the header if it contains a validation sensitive field.

AutoHeaderTitle.default: The string the automatically generated header shall display.

AutoHeaderTitleSupplementsSpacer.default: The string separating the actual title from the strings that're supplemented (values of inputs tagged with the CSS-Class CodBi_HTML_Panel_AutoHeaderTitle_Supplement). Encode surrounding spaces as %20 or \s.

AutoHeaderLevel.default: Which level of enclosing heading the AutoHeaderTitle shall have, e.g. to get a h1 enclosure the value has to be 1.

Scroll.default: states whether the view shall be scrolled when the panel unfolds. default is false.

ScrollToTop.default: states whether a round scroll-to-top button shall be displayed at the bottom-right of the unfolded panel. possible values: "true" (always visible), "auto" (visible only when the panel's content is taller than 1.5x the viewport height), or "false" (hidden). defaults to auto.

Accordion.default: If set, this panel becomes part of an accordion. All panels sharing the same accordion name will be folded when one of them is unfolded.
